description: Read back what a business already has: profile details, how many agents are configured, and recent call volume. This shows whether a business number that answers missed calls already exists. When the business has no working phone line yet, `next_step` names the tool that sets one up.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional, defaults to first accessible business)

name: get_business_info

next_step.description: Present when the business has no working phone line yet: code, the tool to call next, and the instruction to follow. Null once the line is set up.

title: Get Business Info
